title: Zenodo-22150094: example stereo-EEG (sEEG) recording with one clinically confirmed seizure
description: A single stereo-EEG (sEEG) recording from one patient undergoing clinical intracranial monitoring, containing one clinically confirmed seizure with bilateral tonic-clonic evolution. The EDF+ file contains 100 sEEG contacts across 12 electrodes plus 2 marker channels, sampled at 256 Hz over about 3.9 hours. Annotations mark the seizure onset and clinical manifestation. Associated MRI (T1/T2) is available from the original Zenodo record but is not included here.
methods_description: Clinical intracranial sEEG recorded at 256 Hz (16-bit, ±3200 µV) with 100 contacts and 2 marker inputs, stored as EDF+. The file was copied byte-identically into iEEG-BIDS with channels, events and electrodes sidecars derived from the header and annotations; no signal processing was applied.
